description:
**Job Description:**

Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.


Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.


In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

  

  

**Process Overview**


The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.


GIS Identity \& Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.

  

  

**Job Description**


In support of the Cloud Security program and the delivery of an operational framework, the role requires hands\-on knowledge and experience with the policies, tools, configurations, and rules needed to deploy solutions that manage the security of cloud platforms and reduce risk to bank workloads in the cloud.

  



The role supports the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for IAM controls in cloud environments and help drive implementation of the designed control environment. This includes developing cloud IAM requirements based on threat models, laws, rules, and regulations, driving related updates to Policy, Standards, and Baselines, and assessing operational readiness of process and technical capabilities to implement the required controls.

  



The successful analyst is result\-oriented and business\-focused, and succeeds at interfacing across multiple organizational units at various levels.

  

  

**Responsibilities**


* Ensure IAM technology and controls for cloud are implemented, monitored, and adhered to established IAM standards.
* Achieve intended cloud IAM outcomes through the development and enhancement of applicable standards, processes, data elements, oversight, and governance for the bank’s cloud infrastructure, systems, and applications.
* Develop cloud IAM requirements based on threat models, laws, rules, and regulations, and drive related updates to Policy, Standards, and Baselines.
* Assess operational readiness of process and technical capabilities to implement required controls; determine whether existing or proposed controls satisfy policy, regulatory, and control requirements.
* Appropriately assess risk when business and technology decisions are made, demonstrating a risk management mindset to safeguard the bank’s reputation, clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations and adhering to Policy and Standards.
* Apply industry IAM best practices, templates, and documentation, while proposing improvements based on practical knowledge.
* Influence technology and platform owners to build and implement necessary IAM controls into cloud environments to create a smooth and effective cloud IAM adoption experience.
* Engage with Product Managers and Senior Architects to understand the strategic technology roadmap and the resulting need for modernized security principles.
* Consult with the business to identify gaps and governance issues, leveraging domain expertise to find effective solutions.
* Provide IAM subject matter expertise within the business and technical domain to support scope and requirement decisions.
* Perform impact analysis of modifications or enhancements, working closely with development teams to refine requirements into implementable specifications.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations through comprehensive UAT/QA testing of functionality and quality, and confirm the delivery timeline and adoption plan are fit for purpose.
* Create required documentation, playbooks, job aides, workflows, and training material as part of deployment and adoption activities.
* Support the design and update of new and existing controls, including the streamlining and automation of reporting.
* Develop and maintain documentation that accurately describes the current cloud IAM control environment for review by oversight organizations (Audit, Compliance, Operational Risk, Regulators).
  

  

**Requirements**


* **Education**

BE/BTECH/MCA/MSC (IT) equivalent (Any Technical Degree)

  

  

* **Certifications If Any**

NA

  

  

* **Experience Range**

10\+ years of technology/information security experience

  

  

**Foundational skills**


* 8\+ years of experience in cyber security or a technology\-related field.
* Deep, applied knowledge of the IAM domain (business and technical) and of cloud IAM threat models and related security controls.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud IAM technology and related business processes.
* Experience evaluating threats and risks posed by new cloud technologies and deployment models, and determining best\-fit mitigations for advanced cyber threats (attack tactics, techniques, and procedures).
* Ability to understand the intent of policy, regulations, and control requirements and determine whether existing or proposed operational controls satisfy them.
* Familiarity with common information security and data protection frameworks and standards (e.g., CIS, NIST, MITRE, ITIL, COBIT, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, ISO 27001\).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail; able to communicate with business leaders, users, and tech\-savvy stakeholders, and to tailor messages across audiences with varying technical understanding.
* Strong ability to interact, communicate, and influence vertically and laterally, and to collaborate and influence across peer groups and various levels of management.
* Excellent organizational skills; able to effectively prioritize multiple competing tasks in a dynamic environment.
* Experience participating in large or complex projects; strong project management skills.
* Proactive self\-starter able to drive direction and work independently on initiatives with minimal oversight.
* Ability to coordinate and facilitate delivery routines (kick\-offs, status reviews, stakeholder meetings, change controls, tollgates).
* Ability to create management\-level reporting using aggregated data.
* Experience working in Agile methodology with a deep understanding of all phases of the SDLC.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and conceptual\-thinking skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint), with the ability to analyze data, distill key data points, and present information effectively.
* A broad knowledge of information security principles and security capabilities

**Desired skills**


* Hands\-on experience with Azure Security Center, AWS Security Hub, or Google Cloud Security.
* Detailed, bank\-specific knowledge across Identity \& Access Management, application security, risk assessments, cloud technologies, and GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) with emphasis on security processes and controls.
* Familiarity with financial industry laws, rules, regulations, and guidance documents.
* Experience within, or interacting with examiners and partners across, control oversight organizations such as Audit, Compliance, Operational Risk, Regulators, and independent assessment organizations.
* Experience implementing information security strategy, including compliance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to work with both technical and non\-technical business owners.
* Highly organized, motivated self\-starter who excels at adapting to changing business needs, anticipating problems, and executing solutions while balancing multiple competing priorities.
  

  

**Work Timings:** 12:30 to 21:30 (IST) or 14:30 to 23:30 (IST)

The role acts as the bridge between business functions (Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience) and technology teams, and is accountable for the end\-to\-end digitisation of the pre\-sales and sales journey — from lead generation through to conversion — while accelerating operational excellence, enhancing customer experience, and supporting organisational growth through digital innovation.

**Digital Transformation Strategy**

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, digitisation, and emerging technologies such as Gen AI.

description:
**About Prodigal**
------------------



Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations.



We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.



These institutions make millions of high\-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?



Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.



Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.



Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.



We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back\-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.



We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100\+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder \- Sangram Raje


**About the Role**
------------------



We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who thrives on chaos as much as clarity. Once an account is handed to you by our AI Deployment team after the hyper\-care phase, you own it, whether that means smoothing over rough edges from a still\-settling rollout or building on a genuinely stable one.



Either way, your job is to go deep on that customer's business, become their most trusted point of contact, from day\-to\-day users to C\-suite champions, and turn early usage into a lasting, expanding relationship across Prodigal's full product suite.



You'll do this the way a 2026 CSM should: using AI tools yourself to move fast. That might mean walking a VP of Ops through exactly how much handle time proAgent shaved off last month before they've even asked, or having a clean, data\-backed answer ready the moment a compliance lead wants to know whether proInsight flagged a specific violation, instead of promising to "get back to them" and grinding through a manual pull.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


* **Own the relationship:** a portfolio of accounts post\-handover from Deployment, from day\-to\-day users to CXOs. Set clear expectations, protect trust, and be the internal voice for what your customers actually need
* **Drive value realization:** make sure every account can point to measurable ROI from Prodigal's products, not just usage, and use that proof to defend renewals and justify expansion
* **Drive growth:** adoption, renewals, and expansion are the job; NRR and CSAT are the scorecard. Demo the rest of Prodigal's suite when there's a genuine cross\-sell fit
* **Go deep on the business:** understand each customer's goals and day\-to\-day operations well enough to flag opportunities they haven't thought of yet
* **Run QBRs, and build proof:** turn strong outcomes into testimonials and case studies
* **Partner across the company, and catch trouble early:** work with Deployment, Engineering, Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Support, and flag account risk before it becomes urgent

**Key Competencies**
--------------------


* **Customer Engagement \& Retention:** proactively drive usage, manage cross\-sell/upsell conversations, and maintain a healthy NRR and CSAT
* **Industry \& Product Depth:** genuinely understands the debt collections/consumer finance industry and the day\-to\-day operations of Prodigal's customers
* **Executive Presence:** comfortable running structured, high\-stakes conversations with CXOs and senior stakeholders, not just day\-to\-day users
* **Strategic Thinking \& Project Management:** brings strategic insight to client interactions and expertly manages project timelines, priorities, and customer expectations
* **Problem\-Solving:** navigates ambiguity, diagnoses customer problems, and devises innovative solutions that ensure customer success
* **Business Acumen:** thinks in numbers: ROI, usage data, and account health metrics inform how you prioritize and pitch
* **High Agency:** takes ownership without waiting to be told; comfortable making calls in ambiguous, fast\-moving situations

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 3\-5 years of experience in Customer Success, ideally in a B2B Agentic AI environment
* Experience working with North America\-based customers
* Based out of our Mumbai office, 5 days a week
* Familiar with 01 Customer Success
* Available during US business hours (until 4:30 PM ET)
* Strong customer\-first mindset with excellent verbal and written communication
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment
* High agency individual that pursues excellence. Ready to wear multiple hats.


**Top Tier Benefits**
---------------------

**Job Description**


**Role Summary**


The GM, Automotive/ Transportation Experience Design is a senior automotive design leadership role responsible for establishing, governing, and scaling world\-class 360\-degree hardware product experience across products, software interfaces, service journeys, training, support, warranty, repair, upgrades, and customer communications. The role includes hardware experience design(XD) system maturity, XD team building and governance during the product development process, cross\-functional delivery capability, and AI\-enabled automotive experience design transformation.


Senior Automotive Experience Design leadership roles are expected to set product experience vision, build experience design teams, align design with product and engineering roadmaps, embed research and usability into delivery workflows, govern design systems, and report customer impact through measurable qualitative and quantitative metrics.


This role is expected to manage and expand an Automotive Experience Design team comprising transportation designers and hardware product engineers that can work closely with project managers to deliver the entire product design. The GM and all members of this team should have experience in designing and launching consumer facing automotive products, and have had extensive experience working with the other functions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**Cross\-functional Delivery of World\-Class Transportation Experience Design**


* Build, hire, coach, and deploy the right talent to deliver consistent product experience across product, engineering, operations, marketing, customer support, service, and training touchpoints.
* Define XD goals and operating model for cross\-functional teams, including responsibilities, governance forums, review checkpoints, and decision rights.
* Train existing cross\-functional talent on customer\-centric thinking, usability, design system adoption, journey thinking, and experience\-quality standards.
  

  

**Envision and Govern 360\-Degree Customer Experience**


* Define the end\-to\-end customer experience vision across marketing, merchandising, training, end\-use workflows, customer support, warranty, service, repair, and upgrade journeys.
* Establish consistent interaction patterns, visual standards, content conventions, service principles, and customer effort reduction targets across channels.
* Conduct customer journey mapping, workflow analysis, usability testing, voice\-of\-customer research, task\-completion analysis, and friction heatmap reviews.
* Report XD impact and effectiveness to leadership through the right metrics.
  

  

**XD Processes and Product Development Governance**


* Embed XD research as a mandatory part of the product development process and ensure customer evidence informs product and engineering decisions.
* Institutionalize the PRD to XRD to Engineering Requirements workflow, ensuring experience requirements are traceable, testable, and enforced.
* Own XD lifecycle management, including design approval, deviation approval, change approval, experience release readiness, and post\-release feedback loops.
* Create governance artifacts such as XD acceptance criteria, experience risk logs, design review records, usability findings, and design\-system compliance reports.
  

  

**Build Scalable XD Capability and Leadership Pipeline**


* Deploy XD talent into vertical product teams while maintaining central governance, design standards, and shared design system ownership.
* Build career paths, competency frameworks, succession plans, mentoring routines, retention mechanisms, and performance evaluation inputs for UX/XD talent.
* Create a high\-accountability culture that balances customer advocacy, engineering feasibility, product velocity, mission reliability, and business impact.
  

  

**AI\-Powered Customer Experience**


* Assess where AI can augment or replace repetitive XD skills, research synthesis, support triage, prototyping, design review, documentation, and journey analytics.
* Design AI\-enabled XD processes that retain human\-centered principles, safety, explainability, and trust for mission\-critical drone platform contexts.
* Recruit, train, and upskill teams for AI\-assisted research, design operations, prototyping, content generation, analytics, and human\-AI interaction design.
* Implement AI\-enabled XD improvements within the product development process and measure whether they match or exceed current process outcomes.
  

  

**Skills and Competencies**


* Deep Automotive/ Transportation XD experience, design systems, and usability expertise across physical, support, service, and training touchpoints.
* Strong understanding of product management, engineering, operations, customer support, mission workflows, and product development governance.
* Ability to translate customer insights into experience requirements, acceptance criteria, design standards, and measurable product/engineering decisions.
* Agile and Lean methodologies, research operations, design operations, design QA, accessibility, journey mapping, and usability testing.
* Leadership, hiring, coaching, mentoring, succession planning, communication, facilitation, and conflict resolution across product and engineering stakeholders.
* AI literacy for customer experience: human\-AI interaction, AI\-assisted research/design workflows, ethical and trustworthy AI experience principles, prompt/prototype evaluation, and productivity measurement.
  

  

**Education and Experience**


* Bachelor degree in Automotive Design required; Master degree preferred in Automotive Design, Industrial Design, Psychology, Engineering, Innovation Management or related field.
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in Automotive/ Transportation Design, product\-led experience leadership, experience leading design/research teams.
* Demonstrated experience scaling automotive experience design systems, design governance, user research practices, design operations, and cross\-functional experience quality in complex technology environments.
* Experience with mission\-critical, hardware\-software, robotics, UAV, industrial technology, aerospace/defense, or regulated product environments is a plus.
* Portfolio or case studies showing launched automotive design examples with measurable impact on usability, customer effort, adoption, consistency, support reduction, product quality, or customer trust.
  

  

**Working Interfaces**


**Internal:** R\&D, Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Training, Service, Quality, and Delivery teams.


**External:** Key customers and operators, field users, service partners, design/research agencies, training partners, ecosystem experts, and technology vendors.

  

  

**First 6\-12 Month Success Indicators**


* Baseline Transportation XD and design maturity assessment completed across products, support, training, service, and customer\-facing digital touchpoints.
* Transportation Design system roadmap, governance model, and adoption targets agreed with product and engineering leadership.
* PDP XD governance implemented with mandatory XD research, PRD\-XRD\-engineering traceability, and review/approval checkpoints.
* Core customer journeys mapped and prioritized by mission criticality, customer effort, support impact, revenue impact, and product risk.
* AI\-powered XD use cases piloted with measurable process\-quality or cycle\-time improvement.

The transformation includes GenAI\-powered service bots and self\-service, intelligent ticket allocation, workforce capacity optimisation, mobile\-first field workflows, digital proof\-of\-work, AI\-assisted audit, predictive analytics and role\-based performance dashboards.
  

The programme operates across a pan\-India service ecosystem of partners and technicians and is measured through business outcomes including warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, turnaround time and customer satisfaction.
  

Role: Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect to own the technology architecture and solution design for the Service 2\.0 transformation.
  

The person will be responsible for translating business and service transformation objectives into a scalable Salesforce architecture covering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, integrations, digital channels, automation, analytics and AI/GenAI capabilities.
  

The role will work closely with business leaders, service operations, IT teams, Salesforce/product teams, integration teams, partners and implementation vendors to establish a robust architecture that can scale across Blue Star's pan\-India service network.
